subject.title: /stop abort leaves streaming card in idle state, blocking subsequent messages (replies=0)

question: Should the repair for this Feishu post-`/stop` zero-reply bug live primarily in shared reply-operation abort release, Feishu streaming-card settlement, or a coordinated change across both?
rationale: Current source proves an active-abort zero-reply class, but only a Feishu-capable maintainer trace can safely choose the boundary without breaking intentional abort suppression or CardKit closeout behavior.

options.title: Trace then coordinated fix
options.body: Capture the live Feishu `/stop` trace and fix both shared abort admission and Feishu card settlement if the trace shows both states are involved.

options.title: Shared lifecycle first
options.body: Fix the shared reply-run abort release path first and require Feishu proof that streaming cards are closed by the existing idle/fallback path.

options.title: Feishu card closeout first
options.body: Add a Feishu-owned abort close/discard path first, accepting that a separate shared follow-up may still be needed if zero-reply admission remains.

recommendation.title: Trace then coordinated fix
recommendation.body: Capture the live Feishu `/stop` trace and fix both shared abort admission and Feishu card settlement if the trace shows both states are involved.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available routing candidate across the release-era shared reply and Feishu plugin history.
